newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Wolters sees 1997 EPS up some 19.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Wolters sees 1997 EPS up some 19.5 pct.

text.p: Dutch business publisher Wolters Kluwer NV said on Tuesday it expected full-year fully-diluted earnings per share of about 8.40 guilders in 1997, up about 19.5 percent from 1996's 7.03 guilders.
The company had previously forecast that annual growth in earnings per share would amount to at least 15 percent from 1997 to 1999.
"For the full year 1997 a net earnings per share 'fully diluted' of approximately Dfl 8.40 (1996: DFL 7.03) is expected," the company said.

Wolters Kluwer said a further step had been taken in the realization of its financial objective to achieve a growth in net earnings per 'fully diluted' share for the years 1997-1999 of at least 15 percent per year on average.
